<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_invst_pln.InvstInvestmentValidator</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>InvstInvestmentValidator</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var InvstInvestmentValidator = Class.create();
InvstInvestmentValidator.prototype = {
    initialize: function(invGrOrSysId, isSecure) {
        this.invstBase = new InvstInvestment(invGrOrSysId, isSecure);
        this.invstGr = this.invstBase.invstGr;
    },
    _checkIsValidAllocationForInvestment: function(investmentInfo) {
        if (new InvestmentFundingUtil().isInstanceOf(investmentInfo.funding_entity_table, InvstPlanningConstants.SYS_CLASS_NAME_DEMAND)) {
            if ((new InvstDemandConversion()).checkIfDemandHasBeenConverted(investmentInfo.funding_entity_value)) {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(investmentInfo.funding_entity_table);
                gr.get(investmentInfo.funding_entity_value);
                return {
                    demand: true,
                    valid: false,
                    number: gr.getValue('number')
                };
            }
        } else if (!investmentInfo.sys_id && !investmentInfo.investment_exists)
            return true;
        else if (investmentInfo.top_investment)
            return false;
        else if (!this.invstGr.getValue(InvstPlanningConstants.SYSID_FLD) || investmentInfo.sys_id == this.invstGr.getValue(InvstPlanningConstants.SYSID_FLD))
            return false;
		else if(!investmentInfo.isActive)
			return false;
		
        return true;
    },

    _checkIsValidRequestForInvestment: function(investmentInfo) {
		if (new InvestmentFundingUtil().isInstanceOf(investmentInfo.funding_entity_table, InvstPlanningConstants.SYS_CLASS_NAME_DEMAND)) {
            if ((new InvstDemandConversion()).checkIfDemandHasBeenConverted(investmentInfo.funding_entity_value)) {
                var gr = new GlideRecord(investmentInfo.funding_entity_table);
                gr.get(investmentInfo.funding_entity_value);
                return {
                    demand: true,
                    valid: false,
                    number: gr.getValue('number')
                };
            }
        }else if (!investmentInfo.sys_id && !investmentInfo.investment_exists)
            return true;
        else if (!this.invstGr.getValue(InvstPlanningConstants.SYSID_FLD) || investmentInfo.sys_id == this.invstGr.getValue(InvstPlanningConstants.SYSID_FLD))
            return false;
		
		else if(!investmentInfo.isActive)
			return false;
        return true;
		
    },

    validateSelectedItemsToAllocate: function(sysClassName, itemSysIds, entitySysId) {
        var validationResult = {};
        var sysIdsArray = itemSysIds.split(',');
        var itemSysId;
        var childInvInfo;

        for (var i = 0; i < sysIdsArray.length; i++) {
            itemSysId = sysIdsArray[i];
            childInvInfo = this.invstBase.getNonGenricInvestmentDetails(sysClassName, itemSysId, entitySysId);
            var _isValid = this._checkIsValidAllocationForInvestment(childInvInfo);
            if (!gs.nil(_isValid.demand) && _isValid.demand)
                validationResult[itemSysId] = {
                    isValid: _isValid.valid,
                    targetName: _isValid.number
                };
			else
				validationResult[itemSysId] = {
					sys_id: childInvInfo.sys_id,
					isValid: _isValid,
					name: childInvInfo.name,
					targetName: childInvInfo.targetName
				};
			
			validationResult[itemSysId].isPresentAlready = false;
			if(this.invstBase.doesItContainChildInvst(childInvInfo.sys_id))
				validationResult[itemSysId].isPresentAlready = true;
				
        }
        return validationResult;
    },

    validateSelectedItemsToRequest: function(sysClassName, itemSysIds, entitySysId) {
        var validationResult = {};
        var sysIdsArray = itemSysIds.split(',');
        var itemSysId;
        var childInvInfo;

        for (var i = 0; i < sysIdsArray.length; i++) {
            itemSysId = sysIdsArray[i];
            childInvInfo = this.invstBase.getNonGenricInvestmentDetails(sysClassName, itemSysId, entitySysId);
            var _isValid = this._checkIsValidRequestForInvestment(childInvInfo);
			if (!gs.nil(_isValid.demand) && _isValid.demand)
                validationResult[itemSysId] = {
                    isValid: _isValid.valid,
                    targetName: _isValid.number
				};
			else 
				validationResult[itemSysId] = {
					sys_id: childInvInfo.sys_id,
					isValid: _isValid,
					name: childInvInfo.name,
					targetName: childInvInfo.targetName
				};
			validationResult[itemSysId].isPresentAlready = false;
			if(this.invstBase.doesItContainSourceInvst(childInvInfo.sys_id))
				validationResult[itemSysId].isPresentAlready = true;
        }
        return validationResult;
    },
    type: 'InvstInvestmentValidator'
};]]></script>
